title: Fix null/undefined handling in ObjectGrid column normalization
body:
React error #185 (invalid element type) occurred when ObjectGrid's column normalization logic accessed properties on null/undefined array elements or column objects without proper guards.

## Changes

**`normalizeColumns` function**
- Check `columns[0] !== null` before `typeof` comparison
- Return early for empty arrays

**`generateColumns` callback**
- Filter invalid columns before mapping: `col?.field && typeof col.field === 'string'`
- Filter invalid field names: `typeof fieldName === 'string' && fieldName.trim().length > 0`

## Example of Previously Failing Case

```tsx
// This would crash before the fix
<ObjectGrid 
  schema={{
    type: 'object-grid',
    columns: [
      { field: 'name', label: 'Name' },
      null,  // Invalid element
      { label: 'Email' }  // Missing 'field' property
    ],
    staticData: [...]
  }}
/>
```

The fix filters out invalid entries before property access, preventing runtime errors while maintaining backward compatibility.
